name: Embryonic limb and digit morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of forelimb, hindlimb or digits, distinguishing the theme from craniofacial, somite, neural plate and pharyngeal-organ confusables.

qualifier: glycation damage repair and molybdenum cofactor enzymes
name: Methylglyoxal detoxification, glycation repair and molybdoenzyme metabolism
rationale: Members cover methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with protein and DNA glycation repair, plus molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis and sulfite/sulfide oxidation (prosthetic group), which the ROS, glutathione and vitamin B6 confusables lack.

qualifier: tangential interneuron and radial migration, cortical layering
name: Tangential and radial neuronal migration in brain lamination
rationale: All members concern migration of neurons or interneuron precursors and the cortical/hippocampal layering and regionalization they build, separating the theme from neuron-specification, commissure and reelin confusables by its tangential interneuron migration.

name: Chromatin remodelling by BAF complexes and protein acetylation
rationale: Members are SWI/SNF BAF complex assembly, histone/protein acetylation and nucleosome assembly/disassembly, whereas confusables centre on methylation, NuRD and CHD6-9 repression without acetylation.

qualifier: multiciliated epithelia, brain ventricles and sperm
name: Motile cilium assembly and beating in multiciliated cells and sperm
rationale: All members concern motile cilia or sperm flagella (dynein arms, central apparatus, beat frequency, CSF flow, mucociliary clearance), distinct from left-right nodal cilia, primary-cilium IFT, tubulin modification and sperm mitochondrial-sheath confusables.

name: Inner ear hair cell mechanosensation for hearing and balance
rationale: Members are vestibular (gravity, otolith, equilibrioception) and cochlear hair-cell stereocilia/mechanotransduction functions, unlike confusables about inner ear development or generic microvillus actin bundling.

name: Meiosis I homologous recombination and synapsis
rationale: All members concern meiotic prophase I DSB formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex and its checkpoint, whereas confusables cover cohesion/condensation, meiotic chromosome segregation and spindle, or germline epigenetics.

name: Hexosamine and sialic acid biosynthesis and their defects
rationale: Members are UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis with GFPT1, GNE and ALG14 deficiencies, distinct from confusables about sialic/GlcNAc catabolism, mannose and dolichol pathways.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and myogenesis
rationale: Members share skeletal muscle differentiation and myogenic gene expression (including extraocular muscle and lithium response), unlike confusables on myoblast commitment/fusion, contraction, cardiac growth or calcineurin-driven hypertrophy.

core: Negative regulation of innate inflammatory signaling
qualifier: TLR/IL-1 signaling and proinflammatory cytokine production
name: Suppression of TLR/IL-1 signaling and proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members restrain TLR2/4, LPS and IL-1 signaling and IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF production, separating them from NF-kB, positive TLR regulation, inflammasome and IL-10 confusables.

qualifier: complexes I, III and ATP synthase with inner-membrane insertion
name: Inner-membrane insertion and assembly of OXPHOS complexes I, III, V
rationale: Members are assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase and protein insertion into the inner membrane, unlike confusables about complex IV, electron transport, Fe-S clusters or import/cristae.

name: Alditol and glycerol metabolism with fructose biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern polyol (alditol) and glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate metabolism and fructose formation, unlike confusables on fructose catabolism disorders, pentoses, glycerolipid synthesis or the pentose phosphate shunt.

core: Regulation of TLR and IL-1 signaling
name: Regulation of TLR and IL-1 signaling, promoting inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members regulate TLR (TLR3/4, MyD88), IL-1, CD40 and IL-37 signaling and mostly promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike the core TRIF/TAK1 cascade confusable and the inflammasome or cytokine-suppression confusables.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell regulation and primitive/definitive erythropoiesis
rationale: Members govern HSC homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation plus erythrocyte differentiation, unlike confusables on general stem-cell maintenance, late erythroid enucleation or bone marrow cell numbers.

name: Thyroid hormone synthesis and hydrogen peroxide generation
rationale: Members concern thyroid hormone generation, transport and NIS defect together with H2O2/ROS production and breakdown, unlike confusables on thyroid hormone receptor response, sulfonation/iodide or selenium metabolism.

name: Epidermal cornification and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members are keratinocyte terminal differentiation, cornified envelope cross-linking, barrier establishment and epidermal/sebaceous morphogenesis, unlike confusables on hair follicle, keratinocyte proliferation control, adhesion junctions or lipoxygenase lipids.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to AKT and ERK
name: Insulin-like and ALK/LTK receptor signaling to AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are RTK autophosphorylation, IGF1R/IRS/SHC/SOS and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K-AKT (incl. AKT2, glycogen synthesis) and ERK, distinct from FGFR-, ERBB/MET-, RAS/MAPK- and oncogenic-fusion confusables.

core: Intestinal lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly
name: Dietary lipid and vitamin E absorption, lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid digestion/absorption, ABCG5/8 sterol efflux, chylomicron/VLDL assembly and vitamin E transport, unlike confusables on lipoprotein remodeling/clearance, cholesterol homeostasis or bile acids.

name: TKI resistance and signaling of mutant KIT, FLT3, PDGFR
rationale: All members are KIT, FLT3 or PDGFR mutants, their signaling and TKI binding/resistance, whereas confusables add ALK and FGFR mutants/fusions or FLT3 downstream signaling.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vessel regression
name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis including lens and hyaloid regression
rationale: Members concern whole-eye structures (optic cup, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, pigmentation) and developmental apoptosis including hyaloid vessel regression, unlike confusables on retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation.

qualifier: ER chaperone gene induction by ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3
name: UPR transcription factor induction of ER chaperone genes
rationale: All members are ER stress-activated transcription factors driving chaperone and stress genes, unlike confusables on ER stress apoptosis, IRE1/PERK regulation, SREBP or the integrated/mitochondrial stress response.

name: Threonine catabolism within L-amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are threonine catabolism and the general amino acid metabolic terms containing it, distinguishing the theme from glycine/glyoxylate, proline and acyl-conjugation confusables.

qualifier: vitamin D metabolism and sodium-phosphate cotransport
name: Vitamin D metabolism and Na+/phosphate cotransport in mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members cover NaPi-II transporters and their disorders, FGF23/Klotho and PTH regulation of phosphate, and vitamin D activation/inactivation, which the mineralization and dental confusables lack.

name: Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination in cross-link repair and proliferation
rationale: Members centre on Fanconi anemia interstrand cross-link repair and protein mono-/deubiquitination, with modules on mitotic and RB1-linked proliferation control, unlike confusables on polyubiquitin chain types, mitotic checkpoints or BRCA-mediated DSB response.

name: Intestinal epithelial cell development and barrier structure maintenance
rationale: Members concern development and structural maintenance of the differentiated gut epithelium (adhesion, lineage factors), unlike confusables on antimicrobial defense or HNF4-driven absorptive brush-border programmes.
